question: What is the very latest Stellar protocol version live on Pubnet right now?

golden.answer: As of 2026-11-10, Stellar Mainnet (Pubnet) runs Protocol 29, activated on 2026-10-01 at ledger 64717645. Protocol 30 (Bell) has a Mainnet validator vote scheduled for 2026-11-23 17:00 UTC. Read a live ledger or network response and date the observation, because a validator vote can change the version.
keyFacts: Gives the Mainnet protocol version from a dated live-network read.
Takes the version from the network, not from a release tag, vote schedule or docs page.
Warns that a validator upgrade vote can change the version.
avoid: Do NOT state a version as current without a dated live source or a staleness note.
Do NOT infer activation from a release tag or a scheduled vote.
golden.notes: Example as of 2026-11-10: Protocol 29 (activated 2026-10-01), Bell (Protocol 30) Mainnet vote scheduled 2026-11-23 17:00 UTC. Accept a newer dated observation; after the vote, Protocol 30 may be correct.

truth.notes: A complete answer identifies a dated live Pubnet observation and names its source. A release tag, scheduled vote, or documentation snapshot alone does not establish the running version. An official page can relay a live measurement if it identifies the network and observation time. If only documentation is available, distinguish the latest documented version from live state. An honest limitation does not establish the requested current value. Accept newer dated observations and any suitable live provider.
